{} : { error: oneOf(o.error, ACK_ERRORS, "error") }), }; case "rpc": return { t: "rpc", id: str(o, "id"), ...route(o), method: oneOf(o.method, RPC_METHODS, "method"), params: obj(o.params, "params"), }; case "rpc_result": return bool(o, "ok") ? { t: "rpc_result", id: str(o, "id"), ok: true, result: obj(o.result, "result") } : { t: "rpc_result", id: str(o, "id"), ok: false, error: oneOf(o.error, RPC_ERRORS, "error") }; case "ping": return { t: "ping", id: str(o, "id") }; case "pong": return { t: "pong", id: str(o, "id"), serverTime: num(o, "serverTime") }; case "viz_sub": return { t: "viz_sub", ...(opt(o, "to", str) as { to?: string }), on: bool(o, "on") }; case "viz": return { t: "viz", ...(opt(o, "deviceId", str) as { deviceId?: string }), frame: decodeVizFrame(o.frame), }; default: return fail("t"); } }

const q = [ytItem("a"), ytItem("b"), ytItem("c")]; const ids = t.uidsFor(q); expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(3); expect(t.uidsFor(q)).toBe(ids); }); it("keeps an entry's uid when it moves (same object)", () => { const t = new QueueUidTracker(); const [a, b, c] = [ytItem("a"), ytItem("b"), ytItem("c")] as const; const [ua, ub, uc] = t.uidsFor([a, b, c]) as [string, string, string]; expect(t.uidsFor([c, a, b])).toEqual([uc, ua, ub]); }); it("keeps the rest stable when an entry is removed", () => { const t = new QueueUidTracker(); const [a, b] = [ytItem("a"), ytItem("b")] as const; const first = t.uidsFor([a, b]); const d = ytItem("d"); const next = t.uidsFor([a, b, d]); expect(next.slice(0, 2)).toEqual(first); expect(first).not.toContain(next[2]); // dropping it and appending something else never recycles its uid t.uidsFor([a, b]); const again = t.uidsFor([a, b, ytItem("e")]); expect(again[2]).not.toBe(next[2]); }); it("a patched copy (same id and source, same index) keeps its uid", () => { const t = new QueueUidTracker(); const [a, b] = [ytItem("a"), ytItem("b")] as const; const [ua, ub] = t.uidsFor([a, b]) as [string, string]; expect(t.uidsFor([{ ...a, title: "Tagged title" }, b])).toEqual([ua, ub]); }); it("a different item at the same index does not inherit the uid", () => { const t = new QueueUidTracker(); const [ua] = t.uidsFor([ytItem("a")]) as [string]; expect(t.uidsFor([ytItem("z")])[0]).not.toBe(ua); }); it("two copies of one patched item never share a uid", () => { const t = new QueueUidTracker(); const a = ytItem("a"); const [ua] = t.uidsFor([a]) as [string]; const ids = t.uidsFor([a, { ...a }]); expect(ids[0]).toBe(ua); expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(2); }); it("the same object queued twice still yields distinct uids on every pass", () => { const t = new QueueUidTracker(); const a = ytItem("a"); t.uidsFor([a, a]); const again = t.uidsFor([a, a, a].slice(0, 2)); expect(new Set(again).size).toBe(2); const third = t.uidsFor([a, a]); expect(new Set(third).size).toBe(2); }); nodes.name: queueUids.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { QueueItem } from "@/stores/engine"; /** * Stable `uid`s for queue entries, so a controller can `jump` to an entry it * saw in an earlier `state` even after the queue has changed around it. * * The engine store keeps plain items in an array: removing one shifts the * rest, a radio page appends, a tag lookup replaces one item with a patched * copy (`{ ...item, title }`). An entry keeps its uid when it is the same * object (wherever it moved), or a patched copy of the item that sat at the * same index under the same id. Anything else is new. */

nodes.name: QueueUidTracker
nodes.body_text: class QueueUidTracker { private byItem = new WeakMap<QueueItem, string>(); private prevQueue: readonly QueueItem[] = []; private prevUids: string[] = []; private nextId = 1; uidsFor(queue: readonly QueueItem[]): string[] { if (queue === this.prevQueue) return this.prevUids; const used = new Set<string>(); const uids = queue.map((item, i) => { let uid = this.byItem.get(item); if (uid === undefined || used.has(uid)) { const prev = this.prevQueue[i]; const prevUid = this.prevUids[i]; uid = prev !== undefined && prevUid !== undefined && !used.has(prevUid) && prev.id === item.id && prev.source === item.source ? prevUid : `q-${this.nextId++}`; } used.add(uid); this.byItem.set(item, uid); return uid; }); this.prevQueue = queue; this.prevUids = uids; return uids; } }

nodes.name: uidsFor
nodes.body_text: uidsFor(queue: readonly QueueItem[]): string[] { if (queue === this.prevQueue) return this.prevUids; const used = new Set<string>(); const uids = queue.map((item, i) => { let uid = this.byItem.get(item); if (uid === undefined || used.has(uid)) { const prev = this.prevQueue[i]; const prevUid = this.prevUids[i]; uid = prev !== undefined && prevUid !== undefined && !used.has(prevUid) && prev.id === item.id && prev.source === item.source ? prevUid : `q-${this.nextId++}`; } used.add(uid); this.byItem.set(item, uid); return uid; }); this.prevQueue = queue; this.prevUids = uids; return uids; }

nodes.body_text: /** * Translations between the protocol's track/catalog shapes and the app's own * models. Pure functions — the bridge, the RPC handlers and the state * publisher all lean on these, and the tests pin them directly. */ import type { ExploreItem, ExploreShelf, LibraryTrack, YtTrack } from "@/lib/types"; import type { QueueItem } from "@/stores/engine"; import type { Item, LocalRef, Shelf, TrackRef, YtRef } from "./protocol"; const MAX_ART_URL = 2048; /** Only public https art may leave the device: the browser can't load the * `data:` covers cloud/local tracks carry, and they'd bloat every frame. */ /** A `yt` ref as the queue's YouTube Music track. Shaped like a search result * (`track_of` in hm-ytmusic): a lone song is its own "playlist". */ /** What a controller is told about a queue item. Only YouTube Music and this * desktop's own files are playable elsewhere; everything else (cloud, phone, * radio, a phone's cast) is `other`. */

nodes.name: publicArt
nodes.signature: function publicArt(url: string | null | undefined): string | null
nodes.body_text: function publicArt(url: string | null | undefined): string | null { return typeof url === "string" && url.startsWith("https://") && url.length <= MAX_ART_URL ? url : null; }

nodes.name: secsToMs
nodes.signature: function secsToMs(secs: number | null | undefined): number | null
nodes.body_text: function secsToMs(secs: number | null | undefined): number | null { return typeof secs === "number" && Number.isFinite(secs) ? Math.max(0, Math.round(secs * 1000)) : null; }

nodes.name: msToSecs
nodes.signature: function msToSecs(ms: number | null | undefined): number | null
nodes.body_text: function msToSecs(ms: number | null | undefined): number | null { return typeof ms === "number" && Number.isFinite(ms) ? Math.max(0, ms) / 1000 : null; }

nodes.name: ytRefToTrack
nodes.body_text: function ytRefToTrack(ref: YtRef): YtTrack { return { videoId: ref.videoId, title: ref.title, artist: ref.artist, album: ref.album, durationSecs: msToSecs(ref.durationMs), thumbnail: ref.artUrl, playlistId: ref.videoId, playlistTitle: ref.title, isAvailable: true, // A ref doesn't say; video stays opt-in from the Video tab as usual. hasVideo: false, }; }

nodes.name: ytTrackToRef
nodes.body_text: function ytTrackToRef(t: YtTrack): YtRef { return { src: "yt", videoId: t.videoId, title: t.title, artist: t.artist, album: t.album, durationMs: secsToMs(t.durationSecs), artUrl: publicArt(t.thumbnail), }; }

nodes.name: libraryTrackToRef
nodes.signature: function libraryTrackToRef(t: LibraryTrack, deviceId: string): LocalRef
nodes.body_text: function libraryTrackToRef(t: LibraryTrack, deviceId: string): LocalRef { return { src: "local", deviceId, id: t.path, title: t.title, artist: t.artist, album: t.album, durationMs: secsToMs(t.durationSecs), artUrl: null, }; }

nodes.name: queueItemToRef
nodes.signature: function queueItemToRef(item: QueueItem, deviceId: string): TrackRef
nodes.body_text: function queueItemToRef(item: QueueItem, deviceId: string): TrackRef { const durationMs = secsToMs(item.durationSecs); if (item.source === "ytmusic" && item.ytTrack) { return { src: "yt", videoId: item.ytTrack.videoId, title: item.title, artist: item.artist, album: item.album, durationMs, artUrl: publicArt(item.cover ?? item.ytTrack.thumbnail), }; } if (item.source === "local" && item.track) { return { src: "local", deviceId, id: item.track.path, title: item.title, artist: item.artist, album: item.album, durationMs, artUrl: null, }; } return { src: "other", title: item.title, artist: item.artist, album: item.album, durationMs, artUrl: publicArt(item.cover), }; }

nodes.name: control.ts
nodes.body_text: /** * The UI's handle on remote mode: send a transport command to the device the * app is controlling, read the hub clock, move playback, and route the OS * media keys. Wired once by `useHypeConnect`; before that (or with Connect * off) every call is a no-op and the media keys stay local. */ import type { Command } from "../protocol"; import { ackMessage } from "./router"; import { positionNow, type CmdResult, type RemoteView } from "./session"; import { useRemoteStore } from "./store"; import { toast } from "@/stores/toast"; let control: RemoteControl | null = null; /** The hub's clock now (the local clock before Connect is up). */ /** Send `command` to the device being controlled; toasts a failure. */ /** The media-key / tray actions the engine understands. */ /** The remote command for a media key, or null if it has none. */ /** * OS media keys and tray buttons: while this app is a remote they drive the * other device (a media key must not resume the stale local queue and so take * the music back by accident). Otherwise `local` runs as before. */

nodes.name: RemoteControl
nodes.body_text: interface RemoteControl { /** The view of the device being controlled (with the optimistic overlay). */ view(): RemoteView | null; cmd(to: string, command: Command): Promise<CmdResult>; hubNow(): number; moveTo(deviceId: string): Promise<unknown>; }

nodes.name: configureRemote
nodes.body_text: function configureRemote(c: RemoteControl | null): void { control = c; }

nodes.name: remoteHubNow
nodes.body_text: function remoteHubNow(): number { return control?.hubNow() ?? Date.now(); }

nodes.name: sendRemote
nodes.signature: async function sendRemote(command: Command): Promise<CmdResult | null>
nodes.body_text: async function sendRemote(command: Command): Promise<CmdResult | null> { const view = control?.view(); if (!control || !view) return null; const result = await control.cmd(view.device.id, command); if (!result.ok) toast.error(ackMessage(result.error, view.device.name)); return result; }

nodes.name: playOnDevice
nodes.body_text: async function playOnDevice(deviceId: string): Promise<void> { await control?.moveTo(deviceId); }

nodes.name: MediaAction
nodes.body_text: type MediaAction = | "play" | "pause" | "toggle" | "next" | "prev" | "stop" | "seek" | "seekForward" | "seekBackward";

nodes.name: mediaToCommand
nodes.signature: function mediaToCommand( action: string, secs: number | null, view: RemoteView, hubNowMs: number, ): Command | null
nodes.body_text: function mediaToCommand( action: string, secs: number | null, view: RemoteView, hubNowMs: number, ): Command | null { const here = positionNow(view, hubNowMs); switch (action) { case "play": return { type: "resume" }; case "pause": return { type: "pause" }; case "toggle": return { type: view.playing ? "pause" : "resume" }; case "next": return { type: "next" }; case "prev": return { type: "prev" }; case "stop": return { type: "pause" }; case "seek": return secs === null ? null : { type: "seek", positionMs: Math.max(0, secs * 1000) }; case "seekForward": return { type: "seek", positionMs: here + (secs ?? 10) * 1000 }; case "seekBackward": return { type: "seek", positionMs: Math.max(0, here - (secs ?? 10) * 1000) }; default: return null; } }

nodes.name: routeMediaCommand
nodes.signature: function routeMediaCommand(action: string, secs: number | null, local: () => void): void
nodes.body_text: function routeMediaCommand(action: string, secs: number | null, local: () => void): void { const view = control?.view() ?? useRemoteStore.getState().view; if (!control || !view) { local(); return; } const command = mediaToCommand(action, secs, view, control.hubNow()); if (command) void sendRemote(command); }

nodes.name: nowPlaying.ts
nodes.body_text: /** * ONE answer to "what is playing now": this computer's engine, or - while the * app is a Hype Connect remote - the controlled device's track. Surfaces that * show the current song (ambient backdrop, sidebar card, tray) read this * instead of the engine store directly, so none of them needs its own remote * check. */ import type { TrackMeta } from "@/lib/types"; import { useEngineStore } from "@/stores/engine"; import { positionNow, type RemoteView } from "./session"; import { useRemoteStore } from "./store"; /** A remote track as the shared `TrackMeta` (art = the yt thumbnail, if any). */ /** The current song: the remote's while one is controlled, else the local one. */ /** Progress in seconds (`duration` 0 = unknown) for the current song. */ /** The remote's progress at hub time `hubNowMs`: `positionMs + (playing ? hubNow - at : 0)`, clamped (§3.6). */

nodes.name: NowPlaying
nodes.body_text: interface NowPlaying { /** True when the track is playing on another device. */ remote: boolean; /** The other device's name (remote mode only). */ deviceName: string | null; /** Title/artist/album/art; `cover` is null when the source has none. */ meta: TrackMeta | null; }

nodes.name: remoteMeta
nodes.body_text: function remoteMeta(view: RemoteView): TrackMeta | null { const t = view.track; if (!t) return null; return { title: t.title, artist: t.artist, album: t.album, cover: t.artUrl ?? null }; }

nodes.name: selectNowPlaying
nodes.signature: function selectNowPlaying(localMeta: TrackMeta | null, remote: RemoteView | null): NowPlaying
nodes.body_text: function selectNowPlaying(localMeta: TrackMeta | null, remote: RemoteView | null): NowPlaying { if (remote) return { remote: true, deviceName: remote.device.name, meta: remoteMeta(remote) }; return { remote: false, deviceName: null, meta: localMeta }; }

nodes.name: NowProgress
nodes.body_text: interface NowProgress { position: number; duration: number; }

nodes.name: remoteProgress
nodes.signature: function remoteProgress(view: RemoteView, hubNowMs: number): NowProgress
nodes.body_text: function remoteProgress(view: RemoteView, hubNowMs: number): NowProgress { const durationMs = view.durationMs ?? view.track?.durationMs ?? 0; const clamped = positionNow({ ...view, durationMs: durationMs > 0 ? durationMs : view.durationMs }, hubNowMs); return { position: clamped / 1000, duration: durationMs / 1000 }; }

nodes.name: useNowPlaying
nodes.body_text: function useNowPlaying(): NowPlaying { const localMeta = useEngineStore((s) => s.nowPlayingMeta); const remote = useRemoteStore((s) => s.view); return selectNowPlaying(localMeta, remote); }

nodes.body_text: /** * "Pick here, play there" (contract §3.12): the ONE entry point every play * action in the app goes through. * * Not in remote mode → the caller's own local behaviour runs, untouched. In * remote mode the items become `TrackRef`s and go to the active device as * `play` / `enqueue`. What that device can't play (this computer's own files, * cloud and phone-link files, internet radio …) is not sent: if nothing is * left the user is asked whether to play it here instead — which, by Claim, * makes this computer the player — and if only some stayed behind they are * counted in a toast. */ import type { QueueItem } from "@/stores/engine"; import type { AckError, Command, DeviceInfo, EnqueueMode, TrackRef } from "../protocol"; import type { CmdResult } from "./session"; /** A `play` frame stays well under the hub's 256 KiB: ~300 B per ref. */ export const MAX_ITEMS_PER_PLAY = 400; /** Items kept before the tapped one, so "previous" still has somewhere to go. */ const KEEP_BEFORE = 50; const ACK_MESSAGES: Record<AckError, (device: string) => string> = { offline: (d) => `${d} is offline.`, not_a_player: (d) => `${d} can't play music.`, nothing_playable: (d) => `${d} can't play that.`, unsupported: (d) => `${d} doesn't support that yet. Update the app there.`, failed: (d) => `${d} couldn't do that.`, timeout: (d) => `${d} didn't answer.`, }; /** Which of `items` the target can play, with `index` re-based onto them: * the requested item if it survived, else the next playable after it, else * the closest one before it. */ /** At most {@link MAX_ITEMS_PER_PLAY} refs around `start`. */ /* ------------------------------------------------------- the app's router */ let current: Router | null = null; /** Mounted once by `useHypeConnect`; `null` turns routing off. */ /** Play `items` from `index`, here or on the active device. */ /** Queue `items`, here or on the active device. */ /** Whether a play right now would go to another device. */

nodes.name: selectPlayable
nodes.signature: function selectPlayable( items: readonly QueueItem[], index: number, toRef: (i: QueueItem) => TrackRef, ): { refs: TrackRef[]; start: number; dropped: number }
nodes.body_text: function selectPlayable( items: readonly QueueItem[], index: number, toRef: (i: QueueItem) => TrackRef, ): { refs: TrackRef[]; start: number; dropped: number } { const refs: TrackRef[] = []; let start = -1; let before = -1; items.forEach((item, i) => { const ref = toRef(item); if (!isRemotePlayable(ref)) return; if (i >= index && start < 0) start = refs.length; if (i < index) before = refs.length; refs.push(ref); }); if (start < 0) start = Math.max(0, before); return { refs, start, dropped: items.length - refs.length }; }

nodes.name: window
nodes.signature: function window(refs: TrackRef[], start: number): { refs: TrackRef[]; start: number }
nodes.body_text: function window(refs: TrackRef[], start: number): { refs: TrackRef[]; start: number } { if (refs.length <= MAX_ITEMS_PER_PLAY) return { refs, start }; const from = Math.max(0, start - KEEP_BEFORE); return { refs: refs.slice(from, from + MAX_ITEMS_PER_PLAY), start: start - from }; }

nodes.name: Router
nodes.body_text: class Router { constructor(private readonly deps: RouterDeps) {} /** Whether plays currently go to another device. */ get remote(): boolean { return this.deps.target() !== null; } async play(req: PlayRequest): Promise<void> { const target = this.deps.target(); if (!target) { req.local(); return; } const picked = selectPlayable(req.items, req.index, this.deps.toRef); if (picked.refs.length === 0) { const subject = req.items.length === 1 ? `"${req.items[0]!.title}"` : "These tracks"; if (await this.deps.confirm(`${subject} ${req.items.length === 1 ? "is" : "are"} only on this computer. Play ${req.items.length === 1 ? "it" : "them"} here instead?`)) { req.local(); } return; } if (picked.dropped > 0) { this.deps.info(`${plural(picked.dropped, "track stayed", "tracks stayed")} on this computer — ${target.name} can't play ${picked.dropped === 1 ? "it" : "them"}.`); } const { refs, start } = window(picked.refs, picked.start); const result = await this.deps.cmd(target.id, { type: "play", items: refs, index: start, ...(req.radio && refs.length === 1 ? { radio: true } : {}), }); if (!result.ok) this.deps.error(ackMessage(result.error, target.name)); } async enqueue(req: EnqueueRequest): Promise<void> { const target = this.deps.target(); if (!target) { req.local(); return; } const picked = selectPlayable(req.items, 0, this.deps.toRef); if (picked.refs.length === 0) { const one = req.items.length === 1; const subject = one ? `"${req.items[0]!.title}"` : "These tracks"; if (await this.deps.confirm(`${subject} ${one ? "is" : "are"} only on this computer. Add ${one ? "it" : "them"} to this computer's queue instead?`)) { req.local(); } return; } if (picked.dropped > 0) { this.deps.info(`${plural(picked.dropped, "track stayed", "tracks stayed")} on this computer — ${target.name} can't play ${picked.dropped === 1 ? "it" : "them"}.`); } const result = await this.deps.cmd(target.id, { type: "enqueue", items: picked.refs.slice(0, MAX_ITEMS_PER_PLAY), mode: req.mode, }); if (!result.ok) this.deps.error(ackMessage(result.error, target.name)); } }

nodes.body_text: class Rig { hub = 1_000_000; sent: Frame[] = []; failSend = false; timers = new Map<number, { at: number; fn: () => void }>(); n = 1; lost: DeviceInfo[] = []; views: (RemoteView | null)[] = []; s = new RemoteSession({ hubNow: () => this.hub, send: (f) => { if (this.failSend) return Promise.reject(new Error("x")); this.sent.push(f); return Promise.resolve(); }, setTimeout: (fn, ms) => { const id = this.n++; this.timers.set(id, { at: this.hub + ms, fn }); return id; }, clearTimeout: (h) => void this.timers.delete(h as number), onChange: (v) => this.views.push(v), onTargetLost: (d) => this.lost.push(d), }); tick(ms: number) { this.hub += ms; for (const [id, t] of [...this.timers]) { if (t.at <= this.hub) { this.timers.delete(id); t.fn(); } } } }

nodes.body_text: /** * The controller half of Hype Connect on a player (contract §3.12): what the * other players are doing, whether this app is in *remote mode*, and how to * command the device that is playing. * * Pure of I/O — frames go out through an injected `send`, time comes from * injected clocks — so the rules are tested directly. * * - Every other player's latest {@link StampedState} is kept (older `seq` * dropped, forgotten when the device goes offline or on `welcome`). * - Remote mode = connected and `activeDeviceId` names another *online* * device with cap `player`; {@link RemoteSession.view} is that device's * state, with a small optimistic overlay so a tap feels instant. * - {@link RemoteSession.cmd} sends a `cmd` and resolves with the matching * `ack` (or a client-side timeout a little after the hub's own 10 s). */ import type { AckError, Command, DeviceInfo, Frame, PlayerState, QueueEntry, RepeatMode, TrackRef, } from "../protocol"; import { isOnlinePlayer } from "./takeover"; /** The hub answers `timeout` after 10 s; give that reply time to arrive. */ export const CMD_TIMEOUT_MS = 11_000; /** How long a tapped control shows its optimistic value without a newer state. */ export const OVERLAY_MS = 3_000; /** A player's state as controllers see it: stamped with the hub's clock. */ /** The remote device as the player UI shows it. The position is a base value: * {@link positionNow} adds the time elapsed since `at`. */ /** `positionMs + (playing ? hubNow - at : 0)`, clamped to the duration (§3.6). */

nodes.name: positionNow
nodes.signature: function positionNow(v: Pick<RemoteView, "positionMs" | "at" | "playing" | "durationMs">, hubNowMs: number): number
nodes.body_text: function positionNow(v: Pick<RemoteView, "positionMs" | "at" | "playing" | "durationMs">, hubNowMs: number): number { const raw = v.positionMs + (v.playing ? hubNowMs - v.at : 0); const floored = Math.max(0, raw); return v.durationMs !== null ? Math.min(floored, Math.max(0, v.durationMs)) : floored; }

"failed" }); } /** The device the app is remote-controlling, or null (local mode). */ get target(): DeviceInfo | null { if (!this.connected || this.activeId === null || this.activeId === this.selfId) return null; const d = this.devices.find((x) => x.id === this.activeId); return isOnlinePlayer(d) ? d : null; } /** Every online player, this device included, for the picker. */ get players(): DeviceInfo[] { return this.connected ? this.devices.filter(isOnlinePlayer) : []; } get active(): string | null { return this.activeId; } /** The latest known state of any other player (also the non-active ones). */ stateOf(deviceId: string): StampedState | null { return this.states.get(deviceId) ?? null; } /** The target's state with the optimistic overlay, or null in local mode. */ view(): RemoteView | null { const device = this.target; if (!device) return null; const s = this.states.get(device.id); const base: RemoteView = s ? { device, seq: s.seq, track: s.track, playing: s.playing, positionMs: s.positionMs, at: s.at, durationMs: s.durationMs, volume: s.volume, shuffle: s.shuffle, repeat: s.repeat, queue: s.queue, } : { device, seq: -1, track: null, playing: false, positionMs: 0, at: this.deps.hubNow(), durationMs: null, volume: 1, shuffle: false, repeat: "off", queue: [], }; const o = this.overlay; if (!o || o.deviceId !== device.id) return base; const x = o.o; return { ...base, playing: x.playing ?? base.playing, positionMs: x.position?.ms ?? base.positionMs, at: x.position?.at ?? base.at, volume: x.volume ?? base.volume, shuffle: x.shuffle ?? base.shuffle, repeat: x.repeat ?? base.repeat, }; } /** Send `command` to `to`; resolves with the ack. nodes.body_text: private afterDevices(): void { const target = this.target; const prev = this.lastTarget; if (prev && target?.id !== prev.id) { const now = this.devices.find((d) => d.id === prev.id); if (!now || !now.online) this.deps.onTargetLost?.(prev); } this.lastTarget = target; if (this.overlay && this.overlay.deviceId !== target?.id) this.dropOverlay(); this.emit(); }

nodes.name: applyOverlay
nodes.signature: private applyOverlay(to: string, command: Command): void
nodes.body_text: private applyOverlay(to: string, command: Command): void { const s = this.states.get(to); const baseSeq = s?.seq ?? -1; const cur = this.overlay && this.overlay.deviceId === to ? this.overlay.o : null; const next: Overlay = { ...(cur ?? { baseSeq }), baseSeq: cur?.baseSeq ?? baseSeq }; let touched = true; switch (command.type) { case "pause": { next.playing = false; next.position = this.currentPosition(to); break; } case "resume": { next.playing = true; next.position = this.currentPosition(to); break; } case "seek": next.position = { ms: Math.max(0, command.positionMs), at: this.deps.hubNow() }; break; case "volume": next.volume = command.value; break; case "shuffle": next.shuffle = command.on; break; case "repeat": next.repeat = command.mode; break; default: touched = false; } if (!touched) return; this.overlay = { deviceId: to, o: next }; if (this.overlayTimer !== null) this.deps.clearTimeout(this.overlayTimer); this.overlayTimer = this.deps.setTimeout(() => { this.overlayTimer = null; this.overlay = null; this.emit(); }, OVERLAY_MS); this.emit(); }

nodes.body_text: private currentPosition(deviceId: string): { ms: number; at: number } | undefined { const s = this.states.get(deviceId); if (!s) return undefined; const hubNow = this.deps.hubNow(); const live = this.overlay?.deviceId === deviceId ? this.overlay.o : null; const playing = live?.playing ?? s.playing; const base = live?.position ?? { ms: s.positionMs, at: s.at }; return { ms: positionNow({ positionMs: base.ms, at: base.at, playing, durationMs: s.durationMs }, hubNow), at: hubNow }; }

nodes.body_text: private dropOverlayFor(command: Command): void { if (["pause", "resume", "seek", "volume", "shuffle", "repeat"].includes(command.type)) this.dropOverlay(true); }

nodes.name: dropOverlay
nodes.body_text: private dropOverlay(emit = false): void { if (this.overlayTimer !== null) this.deps.clearTimeout(this.overlayTimer); this.overlayTimer = null; const had = this.overlay !== null; this.overlay = null; if (emit && had) this.emit(); }

nodes.body_text: private failPending(error: AckError): void { for (const [id, p] of this.pending) { this.deps.clearTimeout(p.timer); this.pending.delete(id); p.resolve({ ok: false, error }); } }

nodes.name: takeover.ts
nodes.body_text: /** * Claim and Yield (contract §3.12): one device plays at a time. * * A pure state machine — time, timers and the two side effects are injected — * so the rules (including the two-players race) are tested directly. * * - **Claim.** A connected player whose `activeDeviceId` isn't itself sends * `select {self}` when (a) its playback goes from not playing to playing, or * (b) a `welcome`/`devices` shows it playing while the active device is * null, offline or not a player. It is then *claiming* until a * `welcome`/`devices` names it active, the hub answers `not_a_player`, or * 3 s pass. At most one claim per 3 s. * - **Yield.** A player that is playing, not claiming, and sees a * `welcome`/`devices` naming *another online player* active pauses (pause, * not stop). A claiming player postpones the check until claiming ends and * applies it to the latest list. * * - **Claim (c), on `welcome` only.** Claim rather than yield when playback * started while there was no socket, or the active device's `welcome.states` * entry is missing or not playing (a stale selection, e.g. after a merge). * Yield on `welcome` only when neither applies; `devices` frames are * unchanged, and a postponed check after a claim runs as a `devices` check. * * "Playing" is the music engine only; the TV player never reaches this. */ import type { DeviceInfo, PlayerState } from "../protocol"; export const CLAIM_TIMEOUT_MS = 3_000; export const CLAIM_MIN_GAP_MS = 3_000;

nodes.name: Takeover
nodes.body_text: class Takeover { private selfId = ""; private connected = false; private devices: readonly DeviceInfo[] = []; private activeId: string | null = null; private playing = false; private claiming = false; private claimTimer: unknown = null; private lastClaimAt: number | null = null; /** Playback started while there was no socket (set on that play edge, * cleared when playback stops or a claim is sent). */ private offlineStart = false; constructor(private readonly deps: TakeoverDeps) {} setSelfId(id: string): void { this.selfId = id; } /** The hub connection came up (`true`, after `welcome`) or went away. */ setConnected(connected: boolean): void { if (this.connected === connected) return; this.connected = connected; if (!connected) this.endClaim(); } /** Local music playback changed (`playing && !paused`). Only an edge acts. */ setPlaying(playing: boolean): void { const was = this.playing; this.playing = playing; if (!playing) this.offlineStart = false; if (playing && !was) { if (!this.connected) this.offlineStart = true; this.claim(); } } /** A `welcome` frame (§3.12 Claim (c) / Yield differ from `devices`). */ onWelcome( devices: readonly DeviceInfo[], activeDeviceId: string | null, states: Readonly<Record<string, PlayerState>>, ): void { this.devices = devices; this.activeId = activeDeviceId; if (activeDeviceId === this.selfId && this.selfId !== "") { this.endClaim(); return; } if (this.claiming || !this.connected || !this.playing) return; const active = activeDeviceId === null ? undefined : devices.find((d) => d.id === activeDeviceId); if (isOnlinePlayer(active)) { const activePlaying = states[active.id]?.playing === true; if (this.offlineStart || !activePlaying) this.claim(); else this.deps.pauseLocal(); } else { this.claim(); } } /** A `devices` frame. */ onDevices(devices: readonly DeviceInfo[], activeDeviceId: string | null): void { this.devices = devices; this.activeId = activeDeviceId; if (activeDeviceId === this.selfId && this.selfId !== "") { this.endClaim(); return; } if (this.claiming) return; // postponed until the claim ends this.evaluate(); } /** `error {code}` from the hub. */ onError(code: string): void { if (code === "not_a_player" && this.claiming) this.endClaim(); } dispose(): void { this.clearTimer(); } get isClaiming(): boolean { return this.claiming; } /** (b) claim, or the yield check, against the latest device list. */ private evaluate(): void { if (!this.connected || !this.playing) return; const active = this.activeId === null ? undefined : this.devices.find((d) => d.id === this.activeId); if (this.activeId !== null && this.activeId !== this.selfId && isOnlinePlayer(active)) { this.deps.pauseLocal(); } else if (this.activeId !== this.selfId) { this.claim(); // null, offline or not a player } } private claim(): void { if (!this.connected || this.selfId === "" || this.activeId === this.selfId) return; const now = this.deps.now(); if (this.lastClaimAt !== null && now - this.lastClaimAt < CLAIM_MIN_GAP_MS) return; this.lastClaimAt = now; this.offlineStart = false; this.claiming = true; this.clearTimer(); this.claimTimer = this.deps.setTimeout(() => { this.claimTimer = null; this.endClaim(); }, CLAIM_TIMEOUT_MS); this.deps.sendSelect(this.selfId); } /** Claiming is over; apply the postponed yield check (never a new claim). */ private endClaim(): void { const was = this.claiming; this.claiming = false; this.clearTimer(); if (!was || !this.connected || !this.playing) return; const active = this.activeId === null ? undefined : this.devices.find((d) => d.id === this.activeId); if (this.activeId !== this.selfId && isOnlinePlayer(active)) this.deps.pauseLocal(); } private clearTimer(): void { if (this.claimTimer !== null) this.deps.clearTimeout(this.claimTimer); this.claimTimer = null; } }

nodes.name: transfer.ts
nodes.body_text: /** * "Play on <device>" (contract §3.9, §3.12): move playback between this * computer and the account's other players. * * - **this computer → other** — the §3.9 transfer with this device as the * source: `play` (own track + upcoming queue + position) to the target and, * once it acks, pause here and `select` the target. * - **other → this computer** — "Play on this computer": the other device's * track + queue + interpolated position go through the app's own `play` * command handler as if the hub had sent them, then the old device is told * to `pause` (it would yield by itself), and this computer is selected. * - **other → other** — §3.9 exactly like the web does it. * * Items the target can't play (another device's files, `other` sources) are * counted and reported, never silently lost. */ import type { Command, TrackRef } from "../protocol"; import type { StateBody } from "../statePublisher"; import { ackMessage } from "./router"; import { positionNow, type CmdResult, type RemoteView, type StampedState } from "./session"; /** Whether `targetId` can play `ref`: YT Music anywhere, a device's own files * only on that device, `other` (cloud, radio …) nowhere. */ /** `play` for `targetId` from what the source is playing; null when nothing * on it can move. */

[snap.track] : []), ...snap.queue.map((q) => q.track)]; const items = all.filter((r) => playableOn(r, targetId)); if (items.length === 0) return null; const currentSurvived = snap.track !== null && items[0] === snap.track; return { cmd: { type: "play", items, index: 0, ...(currentSurvived && snap.positionMs > 0 ? { positionMs: Math.round(snap.positionMs) } : {}), }, moved: items.length, dropped: all.length - items.length, }; }

nodes.body_text: async function moveTo(targetId: string, d: TransferDeps): Promise<MoveResult> { const self = d.selfId(); const source = d.sourceId(); if (targetId === source) return { ok: false, reason: "same" }; const snap = readSource(source, self, d); const built = snap ? buildTransfer(snap, targetId) : null; if (!built) { if (snap && snap.playing && (snap.track !== null || snap.queue.length > 0)) { // Something is playing but none of it can move. d.error(`Nothing playing on ${d.deviceName(source)} can play on ${d.deviceName(targetId)}.`); return { ok: false, reason: "nothing" }; } if (snap && (snap.track !== null || snap.queue.length > 0)) { // Paused on music that can't move: there's nothing to carry, only the // choice of player, and refusing would leave no way to switch. await d.select(targetId).catch(() => {}); d.info(`${d.deviceName(targetId)} is the player now. What was on ${d.deviceName(source)} stayed there.`); return { ok: true, moved: 0, dropped: 0 }; } // Idle source: just hand over the role. await d.select(targetId).catch(() => {}); return { ok: true, moved: 0, dropped: 0 }; } if (targetId === self) { const played = await d.playHere(built.cmd); if (!played.ok) { d.error("Couldn't start that here."); return { ok: false, reason: "failed" }; } // The old player would yield by itself; say so explicitly for older ones. void d.cmd(source, { type: "pause" }); } else { const result = await d.cmd(targetId, built.cmd); if (!result.ok) { d.error(ackMessage(result.error, d.deviceName(targetId))); return { ok: false, reason: "failed" }; } if (source === self) d.pauseLocal(); else void d.cmd(source, { type: "pause" }); } await d.select(targetId).catch(() => {}); if (built.dropped > 0) d.info(droppedNote(built.dropped, d.deviceName(targetId))); return { ok: true, moved: built.moved, dropped: built.dropped }; }

nodes.name: rpc.ts
nodes.body_text: /** * Remote catalog calls (§3.8), answered through the same IPC the Explore and * Library views use: `search`, `suggest`, `open` and `artist` run on this * desktop's own YouTube Music session; `library` pages its local files; * `lyrics` (v1.1) reads what the Lyrics panel would show. */ import type { ExploreItem, ExploreShelf, LibraryTrack, YtTrack } from "@/lib/types"; import { decodeItem, tryDecode, type RpcError, type RpcMethod, type SearchFilter, } from "./protocol"; import { answerLyrics, type LyricsPort } from "./lyrics"; import { exploreShelfToShelf, itemToExploreItem, libraryTrackToRef, ytTrackToRef } from "./refs"; /** The contract's filters → the app's (`top` is what YouTube calls "all"). */ const FILTERS: Record<SearchFilter, string> = { all: "top", songs: "songs", videos: "videos", albums: "albums", artists: "artists", playlists: "playlists", }; export const MAX_LIBRARY_PAGE = 200; /** hm-ytmusic reports a missing session as "Not signed in to YouTube Music." */ /** Answer one rpc. Never throws: a failure is an `rpc_result` error. */

nodes.name: RpcPort
nodes.body_text: interface RpcPort { /** This desktop's Connect device id (its install id). */ deviceId(): string; /** Whether a YouTube Music session exists (may be cached briefly). */ ytSignedIn(): Promise<boolean>; search(query: string, filter: string): Promise<ExploreShelf[]>; suggest(query: string): Promise<string[]>; exploreTracks(item: ExploreItem): Promise<YtTrack[]>; artistPage(browseId: string): Promise<ExploreShelf[]>; /** The local library, in the order the Library shows it. */ localTracks(): Promise<LibraryTrack[]>; /** A YT call failed for want of a session: forget any cached sign-in. */ forgetSignIn(): void; /** The playing track's lyrics, via the app's own resolver. */ lyrics: LyricsPort; }

nodes.body_text: type RpcOutcome = | { ok: true; result: Record<string, unknown> } | { ok: false; error: RpcError };

nodes.body_text: done = (result: Record<string, unknown>): RpcOutcome => ({ ok: true, result })

nodes.body_text: function isSignedOutError(e: unknown): boolean { const message = typeof e === "object" && e !== null && "message" in e ? String((e as { message: unknown }).message) : String(e); return /not signed in/i.test(message); }

nodes.signature: function matches(t: LibraryTrack, needle: string): boolean
nodes.body_text: function matches(t: LibraryTrack, needle: string): boolean { return [t.title, t.artist, t.album].some((f) => f?.toLowerCase().includes(needle)); }

nodes.name: executeRpc
nodes.signature: async function executeRpc( method: RpcMethod, params: Record<string, unknown>, port: RpcPort, ): Promise<RpcOutcome>
nodes.body_text: async function executeRpc( method: RpcMethod, params: Record<string, unknown>, port: RpcPort, ): Promise<RpcOutcome> { try { if (method === "library") return await library(params, port); // Lyrics come from the app's own resolver, not from YouTube Music. if (method === "lyrics") return done({ ...(await answerLyrics(port.lyrics)) }); if (!(await port.ytSignedIn())) return fail("not_signed_in"); return await youtube(method, params, port); } catch (e) { if (isSignedOutError(e)) { port.forgetSignIn(); return fail("not_signed_in"); } return fail("failed"); } }

nodes.name: youtube
nodes.signature: async function youtube( method: Exclude<RpcMethod, "library" | "lyrics">, params: Record<string, unknown>, port: RpcPort, ): Promise<RpcOutcome>
nodes.body_text: async function youtube( method: Exclude<RpcMethod, "library" | "lyrics">, params: Record<string, unknown>, port: RpcPort, ): Promise<RpcOutcome> { switch (method) { case "search": { const query = stringParam(params, "query"); const filter = stringParam(params, "filter") as SearchFilter | null; if (query === null || filter === null || !(filter in FILTERS)) return fail("failed"); const shelves = await port.search(query, FILTERS[filter]); return done({ shelves: shelves.map(exploreShelfToShelf) }); } case "suggest": { const query = stringParam(params, "query"); if (query === null) return fail("failed"); return done({ suggestions: await port.suggest(query) }); } case "open": { const item = tryDecode(decodeItem, params.item); if (!item) return fail("failed"); // Unavailable tracks can't stream here, so they aren't offered either — // the same rule the Explore view applies before queueing. const tracks = (await port.exploreTracks(itemToExploreItem(item))).filter((t) => t.isAvailable); return done({ title: item.title, tracks: tracks.map(ytTrackToRef) }); } case "artist": { const id = stringParam(params, "id"); if (id === null) return fail("failed"); const shelves = await port.artistPage(id); return done({ shelves: shelves.map(exploreShelfToShelf) }); } } }

nodes.name: library
nodes.signature: async function library(params: Record<string, unknown>, port: RpcPort): Promise<RpcOutcome>
nodes.body_text: async function library(params: Record<string, unknown>, port: RpcPort): Promise<RpcOutcome> { const offset = intParam(params, "offset"); const limit = intParam(params, "limit"); if (offset === null || limit === null) return fail("failed"); const query = stringParam(params, "query")?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? ""; const all = await port.localTracks(); const hits = query ? all.filter((t) => matches(t, query)) : all; const page = hits.slice(offset, offset + Math.min(limit, MAX_LIBRARY_PAGE)); const deviceId = port.deviceId(); return done({ total: hits.length, tracks: page.map((t) => libraryTrackToRef(t, deviceId)), }); }

nodes.body_text: import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest"; import type { PlayerState } from "./protocol"; import { buildPlayerState, createStatePublisher, DEBOUNCE_MS, firstSeq, HEARTBEAT_MS, localStorageSeqStore, MAX_STATE_QUEUE, type EngineView, type SeqStore, type StateBody, } from "./statePublisher"; import { QueueUidTracker } from "./queueUids"; import { DEVICE, localQ, ytItem } from "./testKit"; describe("buildPlayerState", () => { it("is idle with no track when nothing is loaded", () => { const s = buildPlayerState(engine(), DEVICE, new QueueUidTracker()); expect(s).toMatchObject({ track: null, playing: false, positionMs: 0, durationMs: null, queue: [] }); }); it("a queue parked on its last item after a natural end is idle, not paused", () => { const q = [ytItem("a")]; const s = buildPlayerState( engine({ queue: q, queueIndex: 0, order: [0], orderPos: 0, playing: false, nowPlaying: null }), DEVICE, new QueueUidTracker(), ); expect(s.track).toBeNull(); expect(s.queue).toEqual([]); }); it("reports the track, position in ms, upcoming entries in play order, and volume clamped", () => { const q = [ytItem("a"), ytItem("b"), localQ("/c.mp3")]; const uids = new QueueUidTracker(); const ids = uids.uidsFor(q); const s = buildPlayerState( engine({ playing: true, nowPlaying: "Song a", positionSecs: 12.3456, durationSecs: 200, queue: q, queueIndex: 0, order: [0, 2, 1], orderPos: 0, shuffle: true, repeat: "all", state: { masterVolume: 1.4 }, }), DEVICE, uids, ); expect(s.playing).toBe(true); expect(s.positionMs).toBe(12_346); expect(s.durationMs).toBe(200_000); expect(s.volume).toBe(1); expect(s.shuffle).toBe(true); expect(s.repeat).toBe("all"); expect(s.track).toMatchObject({ src: "yt", videoId: "a" }); expect(s.queue.map((e) => e.uid)).toEqual([ids[2], ids[1]]); expect(s.queue[0]!.track).toMatchObject({ src: "local", deviceId: DEVICE, id: "/c.mp3" }); }); it("paused is not playing; falls back to the item's duration", () => { const q = [ytItem("a")]; const s = buildPlayerState( engine({ playing: true, paused: true, nowPlaying: "x", durationSecs: null, queue: q, queueIndex: 0, order: [0], orderPos: 0 }), DEVICE, new QueueUidTracker(), ); expect(s.playing).toBe(false); expect(s.durationMs).toBe(200_000); }); it("caps the upcoming queue at 50", () => { const q = Array.from({ length: 80 }, (_, i) => ytItem(`t${i}`)); const s = buildPlayerState( engine({ playing: true, nowPlaying: "x", queue: q, queueIndex: 0, order: q.map((_, i) => i), orderPos: 0 }), DEVICE, new QueueUidTracker(), ); expect(s.queue).toHaveLength(MAX_STATE_QUEUE); expect(MAX_STATE_QUEUE).toBe(50); }); }); describe("firstSeq", () => { it("is the epoch in seconds when nothing is persisted", () => { expect(firstSeq(1_760_000_000_999, null)).toBe(1_760_000_000); }); it("is one past the persisted value when that is ahead of the clock", () => { expect(firstSeq(1_760_000_000_000, 1_760_000_500)).toBe(1_760_000_501); }); it("is the clock when it is ahead of the persisted value", () => { expect(firstSeq(1_760_000_100_000, 1_760_000_000)).toBe(1_760_000_100); }); it("stays within 32-bit range for today's dates", () => { expect(firstSeq(Date.now(), null)).toBeLessThan(2 ** 31); }); it("ignores a non-finite persisted value", () => { expect(firstSeq(5_000, Number.NaN)).toBe(5); }); }); describe("localStorageSeqStore", () => { afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals()); it("round-trips through localStorage", () => { const mem = new Map<string, string>(); vi.stubGlobal("localStorage", { getItem: (k: string) => mem.get(k) ?? null, setItem: (k: string, v: string) => void mem.set(k, v), }); const store = localStorageSeqStore(); expect(store.load()).toBeNull(); store.save(1_760_000_123); expect(store.load()).toBe(1_760_000_123); }); it("treats garbage as absent", () => { vi.stubGlobal("localStorage", { getItem: () => "abc", setItem: () => {} }); expect(localStorageSeqStore().load()).toBeNull(); }); it("never throws when storage is blocked or missing", () => { vi.stubGlobal("localStorage", { getItem: () => { throw new Error("denied"); }, setItem: () => { throw new Error("denied"); }, }); const store = localStorageSeqStore(); expect(store.load()).toBeNull(); expect(() => store.save(1)).not.toThrow(); vi.stubGlobal("localStorage", undefined); expect(localStorageSeqStore().load()).toBeNull(); }); }); describe("createStatePublisher", () => { let body: StateBody; let listener: (() => void) | null; let sent: PlayerState[]; let seqStore: SeqStore & { value: number | null }; const track = ytItem("a"); beforeEach(() => { vi.useFakeTimers(); vi.setSystemTime(new Date("2026-10-12T12:00:00Z")); body = idle(); listener = null; sent = []; seqStore = { value: null, }; void track; }); afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers()); it("sends immediately on start with seq = epoch seconds, then increments and persists", () => { const p = make(); p.start(); const epochSecs = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000); expect(sent.map((s) => s.seq)).toEqual([epochSecs]); p.publishNow(); p.publishNow(); expect(sent.map((s) => s.seq)).toEqual([epochSecs, epochSecs + 1, epochSecs + 2]); expect(seqStore.value).toBe(epochSecs + 2); }); it("a restart continues above the persisted seq even if the clock is behind it", () => { seqStore.value = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 10_000; const p = make(); p.start(); expect(sent[0]!.seq).toBe(seqStore.value); expect(sent[0]!.seq).toBe(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 10_001); }); it("seq stays monotonic across stop/start within one run", () => { const p = make(); p.start(); p.stop(); p.start(); expect(sent[1]!.seq).toBe(sent[0]!.seq + 1); }); it("coalesces a burst of changes into one send after 300 ms", () => { const p = make(); p.start(); sent.length = 0; body = playing(0); change(); body = { ...playing(0), volume: 0.9 }; change(); change(); vi.advanceTimersByTime(DEBOUNCE_MS - 1); expect(sent).toHaveLength(0); vi.advanceTimersByTime(1); expect(sent).toHaveLength(1); expect(sent[0]!.volume).toBe(0.9); // the latest state, not the first }); it("ignores ticking position alone", () => { const p = make(); body = playing(0); p.start(); sent.length = 0; vi.advanceTimersByTime(8000); body = playing(8000); // exactly where playback should be change(); vi.advanceTimersByTime(DEBOUNCE_MS * 2); expect(sent).toHaveLength(0); }); it("detects a seek: a jump beyond 2 s of where playback should be", () => { const p = make(); body = playing(0); p.start(); sent.length = 0; vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000); body = playing(60_000); change(); vi.advanceTimersByTime(DEBOUNCE_MS); expect(sent).toHaveLength(1); expect(sent[0]!.positionMs).toBe(60_000); }); it("detects a backward seek too", () => { const p = make(); body = playing(100_000); p.start(); sent.length = 0; body = playing(5_000); change(); vi.advanceTimersByTime(DEBOUNCE_MS); expect(sent).toHaveLength(1); }); it("a paused position that does not advance is not a seek, but moving it is", () => { const p = make(); body = { ...playing(30_000), playing: false }; p.start(); sent.length = 0; vi.advanceTimersByTime(10_000); body = { ...playing(30_000), playing: false }; change(); vi.advanceTimersByTime(DEBOUNCE_MS); expect(sent).toHaveLength(0); body = { ...playing(90_000), playing: false }; change(); vi.advanceTimersByTime(DEBOUNCE_MS); expect(sent).toHaveLength(1); }); it("sends on play/pause and on a new queue", () => { const p = make(); body = playing(0); p.start(); sent.length = 0; body = { ...playing(0), playing: false }; change(); vi.advanceTimersByTime(DEBOUNCE_MS); expect(sent).toHaveLength(1); body = { ...body, queue: [{ uid: "q-9", track: body.track! }] }; change(); vi.advanceTimersByTime(DEBOUNCE_MS); expect(sent).toHaveLength(2); }); it("heartbeats every 15 s while playing, and not while paused", () => { const p = make(); body = playing(0); p.start(); sent.length = 0; vi.advanceTimersByTime(HEARTBEAT_MS); expect(sent).toHaveLength(1); vi.advanceTimersByTime(HEARTBEAT_MS); expect(sent).toHaveLength(2); body = { ...playing(0), playing: false }; p.publishNow(); sent.length = 0; vi.advanceTimersByTime(HEARTBEAT_MS * 4); expect(sent).toHaveLength(0); }); it("stop cancels pending sends and heartbeats and unsubscribes", () => { const p = make(); body = playing(0); p.start(); body = { ...playing(0), volume: 0.1 }; change(); p.stop(); sent.length = 0; vi.advanceTimersByTime(HEARTBEAT_MS * 3); expect(sent).toHaveLength(0); expect(listener).toBeNull(); p.publishNow(); // not running: no-op expect(sent).toHaveLength(0); }); it("a failing send does not break publishing", async () => { const p = createStatePublisher({ build: () => body, subscribe: () => () => {}, send: () => Promise.reject(new Error("socket down")), now: () => Date.now(), }); expect(() => p.start()).not.toThrow(); await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(10); }); });

nodes.name: statePublisher.ts
nodes.body_text: /** * The player's half of §3.6: turn the engine store into `PlayerState` and * send it when something a controller shows changed — track, play/pause, a * seek, volume/shuffle/repeat, the queue — coalesced over 300 ms, plus a * heartbeat every 15 s while playing so controllers' extrapolated progress * never drifts far. */ import type { QueueItem, RepeatMode } from "@/stores/engine"; import type { PlayerState } from "./protocol"; import type { QueueUidTracker } from "./queueUids"; import { queueItemToRef, secsToMs } from "./refs"; /** Max upcoming entries in one state (§3.6). */ export const MAX_STATE_QUEUE = 50; export const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300; export const HEARTBEAT_MS = 15_000; /** A position this far from where playback should be counts as a seek. */ export const SEEK_TOLERANCE_MS = 2_000; /** The slice of the engine store a state is built from. */ /** The queue item a controller is told is the current track, or `undefined` * when idle. After a natural end the queue stays parked on its last item, but * nothing is loaded: that's idle, not "paused on track N". */ /** Persistence for the last `seq` sent. Implementations must not throw. */ /** First `seq` of a run: the epoch in SECONDS (monotonic across restarts and * inside 32-bit range), or one past the last persisted value if that is * higher (a clock that stepped back, or a restart within the same second). */ const SEQ_KEY = "hm.connect.seq"; /** `seq` persisted in localStorage; every access is guarded (private mode, * blocked storage, tests without a DOM). */ /** Everything a controller renders except the ticking position. */

nodes.name: EngineView
nodes.body_text: interface EngineView { playing: boolean; paused: boolean; nowPlaying: string | null; positionSecs: number; durationSecs: number | null; queue: readonly QueueItem[]; queueIndex: number; order: readonly number[]; orderPos: number; shuffle: boolean; repeat: RepeatMode; state: { masterVolume: number }; }

nodes.name: StateBody
nodes.body_text: type StateBody = Omit<PlayerState, "seq" | "at">;

nodes.name: activeQueueItem
nodes.signature: function activeQueueItem( s: Pick<EngineView, "queue" | "queueIndex" | "playing" | "nowPlaying">, ): QueueItem | undefined
nodes.body_text: function activeQueueItem( s: Pick<EngineView, "queue" | "queueIndex" | "playing" | "nowPlaying">, ): QueueItem | undefined { const current = s.queueIndex >= 0 ? s.queue[s.queueIndex] : undefined; return current !== undefined && (s.playing || s.nowPlaying !== null) ? current : undefined; }

nodes.name: buildPlayerState
nodes.signature: function buildPlayerState( s: EngineView, deviceId: string, uids: QueueUidTracker, ): StateBody
nodes.body_text: function buildPlayerState( s: EngineView, deviceId: string, uids: QueueUidTracker, ): StateBody { const ids = uids.uidsFor(s.queue); const current = activeQueueItem(s); const active = current !== undefined; const upcoming = active ? s.order .slice(s.orderPos + 1, s.orderPos + 1 + MAX_STATE_QUEUE) .flatMap((qi) => { const item = s.queue[qi]; const uid = ids[qi]; return item && uid ? [{ uid, track: queueItemToRef(item, deviceId) }] : []; }) : []; return { track: active ? queueItemToRef(current, deviceId) : null, playing: active && s.playing && !s.paused, positionMs: active ? (secsToMs(s.positionSecs) ?? 0) : 0, durationMs: active ? (secsToMs(s.durationSecs) ?? secsToMs(current.durationSecs)) : null, volume: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, s.state.masterVolume)), shuffle: s.shuffle, repeat: s.repeat, queue: upcoming, }; }

nodes.name: PublisherDeps
nodes.body_text: interface PublisherDeps { build(): StateBody; /** Call `onChange` whenever the engine store changes; returns unsubscribe. */ subscribe(onChange: () => void): () => void; send(state: PlayerState): Promise<void>; now(): number; /** Where the last `seq` survives a restart. Without it `seq` starts from * the clock alone. */ seqStore?: SeqStore; }

nodes.name: SeqStore
nodes.body_text: interface SeqStore { load(): number | null; save(seq: number): void; }

nodes.name: firstSeq
nodes.signature: function firstSeq(nowMs: number, persisted: number | null): number
nodes.body_text: function firstSeq(nowMs: number, persisted: number | null): number { const fromClock = Math.floor(nowMs / 1000); return persisted !== null && Number.isFinite(persisted) ? Math.max(fromClock, persisted + 1) : fromClock; }

nodes.name: localStorageSeqStore
nodes.body_text: function localStorageSeqStore(): SeqStore { return { load() { try { const raw = globalThis.localStorage?.getItem(SEQ_KEY); const n = raw === null || raw === undefined ? NaN : Number(raw); return Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n >= 0 ? n : null; } catch { return null; } }, save(seq) { try { globalThis.localStorage?.setItem(SEQ_KEY, String(seq)); } catch { // Best effort: the clock alone still keeps seq climbing. } }, }; }

nodes.name: load
nodes.body_text: load() { try { const raw = globalThis.localStorage?.getItem(SEQ_KEY); const n = raw === null || raw === undefined ? NaN : Number(raw); return Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n >= 0 ? n : null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: save
nodes.body_text: save(seq) { try { globalThis.localStorage?.setItem(SEQ_KEY, String(seq)); } catch { // Best effort: the clock alone still keeps seq climbing. } }

nodes.name: StatePublisher
nodes.body_text: interface StatePublisher { /** Begin publishing (sends the current state at once). */ start(): void; stop(): void; /** Send the current state now (e.g. right after a command was applied). */ publishNow(): void; }

nodes.name: significant
nodes.body_text: function significant(s: StateBody): string { return JSON.stringify([ s.track, s.playing, s.durationMs, s.volume, s.shuffle, s.repeat, s.queue.map((q) => q.uid), ]); }

nodes.name: createStatePublisher
nodes.body_text: function createStatePublisher(deps: PublisherDeps): StatePublisher { // `seq` is the last one sent; the first send uses `firstSeq`. let seq = firstSeq(deps.now(), deps.seqStore?.load() ?? null) - 1; let running = false; let unsubscribe: (() => void) | null = null; let debounce: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null; let heartbeat: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null; let last: { key: string; positionMs: number; playing: boolean; at: number } | null = null; const clearTimers = () => { if (debounce !== null) clearTimeout(debounce); if (heartbeat !== null) clearTimeout(heartbeat); debounce = heartbeat = null; }; const flush = () => { if (debounce !== null) clearTimeout(debounce); debounce = null; if (!running) return; const body = deps.build(); seq += 1; deps.seqStore?.save(seq); last = { key: significant(body), positionMs: body.positionMs, playing: body.playing, at: deps.now() }; void deps.send({ seq, ...body }).catch(() => {}); if (heartbeat !== null) clearTimeout(heartbeat); heartbeat = body.playing ? setTimeout(flush, HEARTBEAT_MS) : null; }; const seeked = (body: StateBody): boolean => { if (!last) return false; const expected = last.positionMs + (last.playing ? deps.now() - last.at : 0); return Math.abs(body.positionMs - expected) > SEEK_TOLERANCE_MS; }; const onChange = () => { if (!running || debounce !== null) return; // already coalescing const body = deps.build(); if (!last || significant(body) !== last.key || seeked(body)) { debounce = setTimeout(flush, DEBOUNCE_MS); } }; return { start() { if (running) return; running = true; unsubscribe = deps.subscribe(onChange); flush(); }, stop() { running = false; unsubscribe?.(); unsubscribe = null; clearTimers(); last = null; }, publishNow: flush, }; }

nodes.name: clearTimers
nodes.body_text: clearTimers = () => { if (debounce !== null) clearTimeout(debounce); if (heartbeat !== null) clearTimeout(heartbeat); debounce = heartbeat = null; }

nodes.name: flush
nodes.body_text: flush = () => { if (debounce !== null) clearTimeout(debounce); debounce = null; if (!running) return; const body = deps.build(); seq += 1; deps.seqStore?.save(seq); last = { key: significant(body), positionMs: body.positionMs, playing: body.playing, at: deps.now() }; void deps.send({ seq, ...body }).catch(() => {}); if (heartbeat !== null) clearTimeout(heartbeat); heartbeat = body.playing ? setTimeout(flush, HEARTBEAT_MS) : null; }

nodes.name: seeked
nodes.body_text: seeked = (body: StateBody): boolean => { if (!last) return false; const expected = last.positionMs + (last.playing ? deps.now() - last.at : 0); return Math.abs(body.positionMs - expected) > SEEK_TOLERANCE_MS; }

nodes.name: onChange
nodes.body_text: onChange = () => { if (!running || debounce !== null) return; // already coalescing const body = deps.build(); if (!last || significant(body) !== last.key || seeked(body)) { debounce = setTimeout(flush, DEBOUNCE_MS); } }

nodes.name: start
nodes.body_text: start() { if (running) return; running = true; unsubscribe = deps.subscribe(onChange); flush(); }

nodes.name: stop

nodes.body_text: import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"; import { bassBandCount, bassDb, clamp01, dbToUnit, rebinBands, round2, SOURCE_BANDS, SOURCE_HIGH_HZ, SOURCE_LOW_HZ, unitToDb, VIZ_BAND_COUNT, VIZ_MAX_HZ, VIZ_MIN_HZ, vizLevel, } from "./bands"; describe("dB mapping", () => { it("maps -80 dBFS to 0 and 0 dBFS to 1, linearly", () => { expect(dbToUnit(-80)).toBe(0); expect(dbToUnit(0)).toBe(1); expect(dbToUnit(-40)).toBe(0.5); expect(dbToUnit(-20)).toBeCloseTo(0.75, 10); }); it("clamps outside the range and reads NaN as silence", () => { expect(dbToUnit(-120)).toBe(0); expect(dbToUnit(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)).toBe(0); expect(dbToUnit(6)).toBe(1); expect(dbToUnit(Number.NaN)).toBe(0); }); it("unitToDb inverts it inside 0..1 and clamps outside", () => { for (const v of [0, 0.25, 0.5, 1]) expect(dbToUnit(unitToDb(v))).toBeCloseTo(v, 10); expect(unitToDb(-1)).toBe(-80); expect(unitToDb(2)).toBe(0); }); it("clamp01 and round2", () => { expect(clamp01(-0.1)).toBe(0); expect(clamp01(1.1)).toBe(1); expect(clamp01(Number.NaN)).toBe(0); expect(clamp01(Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)).toBe(0); expect(clamp01(0.3)).toBe(0.3); expect(round2(0.123456)).toBe(0.12); expect(round2(0.999)).toBe(1); }); }); describe("rebinBands", () => { it("always returns the contract's 32 bands", () => { expect(rebinBands(zeros())).toHaveLength(32); expect(rebinBands([])).toEqual(new Array(32).fill(0)); expect(rebinBands([0.5])).toHaveLength(32); }); it("keeps silence silent and a flat spectrum flat", () => { expect(rebinBands(zeros())).toEqual(new Array(32).fill(0)); expect(rebinBands(filled(0.5))).toEqual(new Array(32).fill(0.5)); expect(rebinBands(filled(1))).toEqual(new Array(32).fill(1)); }); it("puts a 1 kHz tone in the 1 kHz band and nowhere far from it", () => { const s = zeros(); s[sourceIndexAt(1000)] = 0.9; const out = rebinBands(s); const at = targetIndexAt(1000); expect(out[at]).toBe(0.9); // Spreads at most into the neighbour a wide source band also touches. expect(out.filter((v) => v > 0).length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2); for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) { if (Math.abs(i - at) > 1) expect(out[i], `band ${i}`).toBe(0); } }); it("keeps low-first order: bass lights the low bands, treble the high ones", () => { const bass = zeros(); bass[sourceIndexAt(60)] = 1; const treble = zeros(); treble[sourceIndexAt(8000)] = 1; const b = rebinBands(bass); const t = rebinBands(treble); expect(b.indexOf(1)).toBeLessThan(6); expect(t.indexOf(1)).toBeGreaterThan(24); }); it("takes the loudest source band under a target (a bin's peak, not an average)", () => { const s = zeros(); const k = sourceIndexAt(1000); s[k] = 0.4; s[k + 1] = 0.8; const out = rebinBands(s); expect(Math.max(...out)).toBe(0.8); }); it("ignores what lies below 30 Hz and above 16 kHz", () => { const sub = zeros(); sub[0] = 1; // 20-21.4 Hz expect(rebinBands(sub)).toEqual(new Array(32).fill(0)); const air = zeros(); for (let k = sourceIndexAt(17_000); k < SOURCE_BANDS; k++) air[k] = 1; expect(rebinBands(air)).toEqual(new Array(32).fill(0)); }); it("lights a target only for a source band that overlaps it by a quarter of its width", () => { const srcW = Math.log(SOURCE_HIGH_HZ / SOURCE_LOW_HZ) / SOURCE_BANDS; const tgtW = Math.log(VIZ_MAX_HZ / VIZ_MIN_HZ) / VIZ_BAND_COUNT; let slivers = 0; for (let k = 0; k < SOURCE_BANDS; k++) { const s = zeros(); s[k] = 1; const out = rebinBands(s); const a = Math.log(SOURCE_LOW_HZ) + k * srcW; for (let i = 0; i < VIZ_BAND_COUNT; i++) { const from = Math.log(VIZ_MIN_HZ) + i * tgtW; const overlap = Math.min(from + tgtW, a + srcW) - Math.max(from, a); if (overlap > 0 && overlap < 0.25 * srcW) { slivers += 1; expect(out[i], `source ${k} only grazes target ${i}`).toBe(0); } if (overlap >= 0.25 * srcW) expect(out[i], `source ${k} -> target ${i}`).toBe(1); } // …and every audible source band lights at least one target in range. const centreHz = SOURCE_LOW_HZ * (SOURCE_HIGH_HZ / SOURCE_LOW_HZ) ** ((k + 0.5) / SOURCE_BANDS); if (centreHz > VIZ_MIN_HZ * 1.2 && centreHz < VIZ_MAX_HZ / 1.2) { expect(Math.max(...out), `source ${k} (${centreHz.toFixed(0)} Hz) vanished`).toBe(1); } } expect(slivers, "the geometry has grazing overlaps, or this test proves nothing").toBeGreaterThan(5); }); it("clamps out-of-range input and reads NaN as silence", () => { const s = zeros(); s[sourceIndexAt(1000)] = 5; s[sourceIndexAt(100)] = Number.NaN; s[sourceIndexAt(4000)] = -3; const out = rebinBands(s); expect(Math.max(...out)).toBe(1); expect(Math.min(...out)).toBe(0); expect(out.every((v) => v >= 0 && v <= 1 && Number.isFinite(v))).toBe(true); }); it("rounds to two decimals like the contract's examples", () => { expect(rebinBands(filled(0.123456))[10]).toBe(0.12); }); it("silences targets above a low sample rate's top band", () => { // 22.05 kHz Nyquist -> the source tops out at ~10.9 kHz. const out = rebinBands(filled(1), 10_900); expect(out[VIZ_BAND_COUNT - 1]).toBe(0); expect(out[0]).toBe(1); }); it("copes with a different source resolution", () => { const out = rebinBands(new Array(16).fill(0.7)); expect(out).toEqual(new Array(32).fill(0.7)); }); }); describe("vizLevel", () => { it("is 0 for silence or nothing, 1 at full scale, and follows a flat level", () => { expect(vizLevel([])).toBe(0); expect(vizLevel(zeros())).toBe(0); expect(vizLevel(filled(1))).toBe(1); expect(vizLevel(filled(0.5))).toBe(0.5); }); it("is the MEAN power, not the sum or the max", () => { const one = zeros(); one[10] = 1; // one band at 0 dBFS, 63 at -80 // mean power = 1/64 -> -18.06 dBFS -> 0.774 expect(vizLevel(one)).toBe(0.77); }); it("clamps garbage", () => { expect(vizLevel(filled(7))).toBe(1); expect(vizLevel(filled(Number.NaN))).toBe(0); }); }); describe("bass", () => { it("covers the bands below 150 Hz", () => { expect(bassBandCount()).toBe(19); expect(bassBandCount(32)).toBeLessThan(bassBandCount()); expect(bassBandCount(1)).toBe(1); }); it("is the mean power of those bands in dBFS", () => { const s = zeros(); for (let k = 0; k < 19; k++) s[k] = 0.5; // -40 dBFS expect(bassDb(s)).toBeCloseTo(-40, 6); s[40] = 1; // outside the bass: ignored expect(bassDb(s)).toBeCloseTo(-40, 6); }); it("is the floor for silence or no data", () => { expect(bassDb(zeros())).toBeCloseTo(-80, 6); expect(bassDb([])).toBe(-80); }); });

nodes.name: bands.ts
nodes.body_text: /** * From the engine's spectrum to the contract's `VizFrame` numbers (§3.11). * * # What the engine gives us * * `EngineFrame.spectrum` is NOT raw FFT bins: `hm-audio`'s `Analyzer` * (`crates/hm-audio/src/spectrum.rs`) already folds a 2048-point FFT (Hann * window) into {@link SOURCE_BANDS} log-spaced bands from {@link SOURCE_LOW_HZ} * to {@link SOURCE_HIGH_HZ} (20 kHz, or 0.99 x Nyquist below a 40 kHz sample * rate — the frame doesn't carry the rate, so 20 kHz is assumed), each the * loudest bin in its range, in dB, and maps it `-80 dBFS -> 0 .. 0 dBFS -> 1`, * clamped. That is the very mapping the contract wants, so no dB conversion is * needed on the way out: the work here is re-binning 64 bands over 20 Hz-20 kHz * onto 32 over 30 Hz-16 kHz, and measuring the level and the bass. */ export const SOURCE_BANDS = 64; export const SOURCE_LOW_HZ = 20; export const SOURCE_HIGH_HZ = 20_000; export const VIZ_BAND_COUNT = 32; export const VIZ_MIN_HZ = 30; export const VIZ_MAX_HZ = 16_000; /** dBFS that maps to 0 (0 dBFS maps to 1). */ export const VIZ_FLOOR_DB = -80; /** Bass is what a kick and an 808 put below this. */ export const BASS_MAX_HZ = 150; /** A source band must overlap a target by this share of its own width to * count toward it, so a sliver at the edge doesn't bleed its neighbour in. */ const MIN_OVERLAP = 0.25; /** A value clamped to 0..1; NaN and infinities are silence. */ /** dBFS -> 0..1 linearly over {@link VIZ_FLOOR_DB}..0, clamped; NaN is silence. */ /** The inverse of {@link dbToUnit} inside 0..1. */ /** Position on the natural-log frequency axis. */ const ln = Math.log; /** * Re-bins `source` (log-spaced, low first, each 0..1) onto the contract's 32 * log-spaced bands from 30 Hz to 16 kHz. * * A target takes the loudest source band that overlaps it enough: each source * value is already the loudest bin of its range, so the max over several is * the loudest bin of their union. A target entirely outside the source's range * (only possible if `sourceHighHz` is below 16 kHz) is silent. */ /** * Overall loudness 0..1: the mean power of the bands, as dBFS, mapped like the * bands. The mean, not the sum — each band is already a per-bin level, so * summing 64 of them would read ~18 dB too loud. */ /** Source bands whose range lies below {@link BASS_MAX_HZ}. */ /** Loudness of the bass in dBFS: the mean power of the lowest bands. */

nodes.name: round2
nodes.body_text: round2 = (v: number): number => Math.round(v * 100) / 100

nodes.name: clamp01
nodes.body_text: function clamp01(v: number): number { return Number.isFinite(v) ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v)) : 0; }

nodes.name: dbToUnit
nodes.body_text: function dbToUnit(db: number): number { if (Number.isNaN(db)) return 0; return clamp01((db - VIZ_FLOOR_DB) / -VIZ_FLOOR_DB); }

nodes.name: unitToDb
nodes.body_text: function unitToDb(unit: number): number { return VIZ_FLOOR_DB + clamp01(unit) * -VIZ_FLOOR_DB; }

nodes.name: rebinBands
nodes.signature: function rebinBands(source: readonly number[], sourceHighHz: number = SOURCE_HIGH_HZ): number[]
nodes.body_text: function rebinBands(source: readonly number[], sourceHighHz: number = SOURCE_HIGH_HZ): number[] { const out = new Array<number>(VIZ_BAND_COUNT).fill(0); const n = source.length; if (n === 0 || !(sourceHighHz > SOURCE_LOW_HZ)) return out; const srcLo = ln(SOURCE_LOW_HZ); const srcW = (ln(sourceHighHz) - srcLo) / n; const tgtLo = ln(VIZ_MIN_HZ); const tgtW = (ln(VIZ_MAX_HZ) - tgtLo) / VIZ_BAND_COUNT; for (let i = 0; i < VIZ_BAND_COUNT; i++) { const from = tgtLo + i * tgtW; const to = from + tgtW; let best = -1; // loudest qualifying band let widest = 0; // largest overlap seen let widestValue = 0; for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const a = srcLo + k * srcW; const overlap = Math.min(to, a + srcW) - Math.max(from, a); if (overlap <= 0) continue; const value = clamp01(source[k] ?? 0); if (overlap >= MIN_OVERLAP * srcW && value > best) best = value; if (overlap > widest) { widest = overlap; widestValue = value; } } out[i] = round2(best >= 0 ? best : widestValue); } return out; }

nodes.name: vizLevel
nodes.body_text: function vizLevel(source: readonly number[]): number { if (source.length === 0) return 0; let power = 0; for (const v of source) power += 10 ** (unitToDb(v) / 10); return round2(dbToUnit(10 * Math.log10(power / source.length))); }

nodes.name: bassBandCount
nodes.signature: function bassBandCount(n: number = SOURCE_BANDS, sourceHighHz: number = SOURCE_HIGH_HZ): number
nodes.body_text: function bassBandCount(n: number = SOURCE_BANDS, sourceHighHz: number = SOURCE_HIGH_HZ): number { const share = ln(BASS_MAX_HZ / SOURCE_LOW_HZ) / ln(sourceHighHz / SOURCE_LOW_HZ); return Math.max(1, Math.min(n, Math.round(n * share))); }

nodes.name: bassDb
nodes.signature: function bassDb(source: readonly number[], bands: number = bassBandCount(source.length)): number
nodes.body_text: function bassDb(source: readonly number[], bands: number = bassBandCount(source.length)): number { const k = Math.min(bands, source.length); if (k === 0) return VIZ_FLOOR_DB; let power = 0; for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) power += 10 ** (unitToDb(source[i] ?? 0) / 10); return 10 * Math.log10(power / k); }
